card.name: Partway through long medical terms
card.fires_on: Partway through long medical words, such as plethysmography, noradrenergic, anaphylaxis and thrombocytosis, at a split where the rest of the word must follow. It also fires on 'and' joining paired adjectives like chronotropic and inotropic.

modes.label: Inside split medical words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long clinical term whose ending is still to come.
modes.example: Hypokalemia and Thromboc<<yt>>osis Due to Intense Treatment of Meg

modes.label: And between paired terms
modes.description: The word 'and' linking two similar technical adjectives.
modes.example: because of negative chronotropic<< and>> inotropic effects.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the rest of the long word, while discouraging other prefix-like word starts.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long medical word, when the rest of the word is still to come.
